messages.text: What is EVM, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

EVM is Error Vector Magnitude, and in the 5G NR FR1 SA UE pre-conformance context it is a measurement of the difference between a reference waveform and a measured waveform [3][4].
In Rohde & Schwarz base-station Tx context, modulation quality is the difference between the measured carrier signal and the reference signal, it can be expressed as EVM, and EVM is the difference reading between equalized ideal symbols and measured symbols, with that difference called the error vector [53].
The UE pass/fail-limit decision depends on modulation and test tolerance, because the cited 3GPP TS 38.521-1 limits are Pi/2-BPSK 30+TT %, QPSK 17.5+TT %, 16QAM 12.5+TT %, 64QAM 8+TT %, and 256QAM 3.5+TT %, with TT values depending on 256QAM max/min power conditions [1].
The UE test-configuration decision depends on EVM because the 3GPP TS 38.521-1 test case is 6.4.2.1 EVM PUCCH/PUSCH, the Test ID sets RB allocation and modulation scheme, and the measured DUT EVM must be confirmed within the specified range after configuration [3].
The UE power-condition decision depends on EVM because the test case requires EVM measurement at DUT max power and min power, with CMX first setting max power automatically and the DUT then being set to min power using TPC Closed Loop settings [3].
The standards-scope decision depends on EVM because the knowledge base warns not to infer all FR1, FR2, Wi-Fi, LTE, NR, or production-line EVM limits from the cited page, and formal pass/fail limits must be checked against the relevant standard, instrument documents, software version, and test condition [2].
For R&S CMX500, the NR FR1 measurement-option decision depends on EVM because R&S CMX-KM600 is required for any NR FR1 uplink TX tests, and its 5G NR analyzer specification includes EVM < 0.5% under the stated FR1, SCS 30 kHz, 16QAM, +15 °C to +35 °C, input-level, and 100 MHz bandwidth conditions [22].
For R&S CMX500 signal generation, the R&S CMX-KW601 option decision depends on EVM because its 5G NR generator specification includes EVM < 0.5% for 5G NR PDSCH, full allocation, SCS 30 kHz / 60 kHz, 64QAM, PAR 11.8 dB, +15 °C to +35 °C, specified ports, –5 dBm output level, and 100 MHz bandwidth [22].
For CMX500 ordering, the cited complete order numbers are R&S CMX-KM600 5G NR analyzer 1222.4013.02 and R&S CMX-KW601 5G NR generator 1222.1920.02 [26].
For FR2 CMX setups, the RF frontend level-range decision depends on EVM because R&S CMX-RF42E provides specified TX/downlink and RX/uplink output level ranges “for best EVM” in the CMX500 + 2 × CMXHEAD50 + CMX-RF42E setup [25][29].
For SRS RF measurements on CMX500, the measurement-scenario decision depends on EVM because the CMX500 SRS RF measurement use case covers TX power, EVM, and more for 5G NR SRS modes/configurations, including SRS antenna switching and carrier switching scenarios [33][34].
FSET3 for SRS carrier switching but does not provide the complete order number or confirm whether R&S CMX-KM600, R&S CMX-KM604, receiver-chain hardware, or other measurement options are required [35].
For R&S base-station conducted transmitter testing, the instrument-selection decision depends on EVM because GFM313 covers 5G NR conducted base-station transmitter tests according to TS 38.141-1 Rel. 16 and includes modulation-quality/EVM requirements of QPSK 18.5%, 16QAM 13.5%, 64QAM 9%, and 256QAM 4.5% [53][54][55].
For that GFM313 context, applicable Rohde & Schwarz products include R&S FSW, R&S FSV3000, R&S FSVA3000, R&S FSV, R&S FSVA, R&S FPS, R&S SMW200A, R&S SMBV100B, and R&S VSE Signal Analysis Software [57].
For R&S base-station conformance setup, the analyzer/generator role decision depends on EVM because the R&S setup figures connect BS type 1-C output power, output power dynamics, frequency error, EVM, and unwanted emissions to R&S FSVA3000, while transmitter intermodulation examples use R&S SMW200A for wanted, modulated interferer, and CW interferer contexts [44].
For R&S FSV3000-family firmware, the option decision depends on EVM because R&S FSV3-K147 is “5G NR combined ACLR/SEM/EVM” and requires R&S FSV3-K144, while R&S FSV3-K147C adds combined multicarrier ACLR/SEM/EVM measurements and requires R&S FSV3-K147 [62].
For R&S SMM100A, the signal-source capability decision depends on EVM because the SMM100A specifications list signal performance examples including 5G NR EVM with R&S SMM-K144, 3GPP FDD EVM with R&S SMM-K42, and IEEE 802.11be EVM with R&S SMM-K147 [11].
For R&S SMM100A measurement-context fit, the product facts are that it is a Rohde & Schwarz vector signal generator covering 100 kHz to 44 GHz, supporting up to 2 GHz internal RF modulation bandwidth, and supporting 5G NR FR1/FR2, ARB, real-time baseband, custom digital modulation, envelope tracking, and HUMS [61].
【推論】Understanding EVM is needed before choosing a standard limit, modulation, Test ID, and power condition, because the cited EVM limits vary by modulation and TT while the test case sets RB allocation/modulation and requires max-power and min-power EVM checks [1][3].
【推論】Understanding EVM is needed before choosing R&S analyzer, generator, frontend, and firmware options, because the CMX500, CMX-RF42E, SMM100A, and FSV3000 cited product passages explicitly specify EVM performance, best-EVM level ranges, EVM signal-performance examples, or EVM measurement options [11][22][25][29][62].

data.answer:
EVM is Error Vector Magnitude, and in the 5G NR FR1 SA UE pre-conformance context it is a measurement of the difference between a reference waveform and a measured waveform [3][4].
In Rohde & Schwarz base-station Tx context, modulation quality is the difference between the measured carrier signal and the reference signal, it can be expressed as EVM, and EVM is the difference reading between equalized ideal symbols and measured symbols, with that difference called the error vector [53].
The UE pass/fail-limit decision depends on modulation and test tolerance, because the cited 3GPP TS 38.521-1 limits are Pi/2-BPSK 30+TT %, QPSK 17.5+TT %, 16QAM 12.5+TT %, 64QAM 8+TT %, and 256QAM 3.5+TT %, with TT values depending on 256QAM max/min power conditions [1].
The UE test-configuration decision depends on EVM because the 3GPP TS 38.521-1 test case is 6.4.2.1 EVM PUCCH/PUSCH, the Test ID sets RB allocation and modulation scheme, and the measured DUT EVM must be confirmed within the specified range after configuration [3].
The UE power-condition decision depends on EVM because the test case requires EVM measurement at DUT max power and min power, with CMX first setting max power automatically and the DUT then being set to min power using TPC Closed Loop settings [3].
The standards-scope decision depends on EVM because the knowledge base warns not to infer all FR1, FR2, Wi-Fi, LTE, NR, or production-line EVM limits from the cited page, and formal pass/fail limits must be checked against the relevant standard, instrument documents, software version, and test condition [2].
For R&S CMX500, the NR FR1 measurement-option decision depends on EVM because R&S CMX-KM600 is required for any NR FR1 uplink TX tests, and its 5G NR analyzer specification includes EVM < 0.5% under the stated FR1, SCS 30 kHz, 16QAM, +15 °C to +35 °C, input-level, and 100 MHz bandwidth conditions [22].
For R&S CMX500 signal generation, the R&S CMX-KW601 option decision depends on EVM because its 5G NR generator specification includes EVM < 0.5% for 5G NR PDSCH, full allocation, SCS 30 kHz / 60 kHz, 64QAM, PAR 11.8 dB, +15 °C to +35 °C, specified ports, –5 dBm output level, and 100 MHz bandwidth [22].
For CMX500 ordering, the cited complete order numbers are R&S CMX-KM600 5G NR analyzer 1222.4013.02 and R&S CMX-KW601 5G NR generator 1222.1920.02 [26].
For FR2 CMX setups, the RF frontend level-range decision depends on EVM because R&S CMX-RF42E provides specified TX/downlink and RX/uplink output level ranges “for best EVM” in the CMX500 + 2 × CMXHEAD50 + CMX-RF42E setup [25][29].
For SRS RF measurements on CMX500, the measurement-scenario decision depends on EVM because the CMX500 SRS RF measurement use case covers TX power, EVM, and more for 5G NR SRS modes/configurations, including SRS antenna switching and carrier switching scenarios [33][34].
FSET3 for SRS carrier switching but does not provide the complete order number or confirm whether R&S CMX-KM600, R&S CMX-KM604, receiver-chain hardware, or other measurement options are required [35].
For R&S base-station conducted transmitter testing, the instrument-selection decision depends on EVM because GFM313 covers 5G NR conducted base-station transmitter tests according to TS 38.141-1 Rel. 16 and includes modulation-quality/EVM requirements of QPSK 18.5%, 16QAM 13.5%, 64QAM 9%, and 256QAM 4.5% [53][54][55].
For that GFM313 context, applicable Rohde & Schwarz products include R&S FSW, R&S FSV3000, R&S FSVA3000, R&S FSV, R&S FSVA, R&S FPS, R&S SMW200A, R&S SMBV100B, and R&S VSE Signal Analysis Software [57].
For R&S base-station conformance setup, the analyzer/generator role decision depends on EVM because the R&S setup figures connect BS type 1-C output power, output power dynamics, frequency error, EVM, and unwanted emissions to R&S FSVA3000, while transmitter intermodulation examples use R&S SMW200A for wanted, modulated interferer, and CW interferer contexts [44].
For R&S FSV3000-family firmware, the option decision depends on EVM because R&S FSV3-K147 is “5G NR combined ACLR/SEM/EVM” and requires R&S FSV3-K144, while R&S FSV3-K147C adds combined multicarrier ACLR/SEM/EVM measurements and requires R&S FSV3-K147 [62].
For R&S SMM100A, the signal-source capability decision depends on EVM because the SMM100A specifications list signal performance examples including 5G NR EVM with R&S SMM-K144, 3GPP FDD EVM with R&S SMM-K42, and IEEE 802.11be EVM with R&S SMM-K147 [11].
For R&S SMM100A measurement-context fit, the product facts are that it is a Rohde & Schwarz vector signal generator covering 100 kHz to 44 GHz, supporting up to 2 GHz internal RF modulation bandwidth, and supporting 5G NR FR1/FR2, ARB, real-time baseband, custom digital modulation, envelope tracking, and HUMS [61].
【推論】Understanding EVM is needed before choosing a standard limit, modulation, Test ID, and power condition, because the cited EVM limits vary by modulation and TT while the test case sets RB allocation/modulation and requires max-power and min-power EVM checks [1][3].
【推論】Understanding EVM is needed before choosing R&S analyzer, generator, frontend, and firmware options, because the CMX500, CMX-RF42E, SMM100A, and FSV3000 cited product passages explicitly specify EVM performance, best-EVM level ranges, EVM signal-performance examples, or EVM measurement options [11][22][25][29][62].

EVM › 1C111 中的 5G NR EVM limits
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]，EVM measurement results 必須低於 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] Table 6.4.2.1.5-1 的 maximum error percentage，並套用 Table 6.4.2.1.5-2 定義的 Test Tolerance（TT）。來源摘錄的 Average EVM Level limits 為：

| Modulation | Average EVM level limit |
|---|---|
| Pi/2-BPSK | 30 + TT % |
| QPSK | 17.5 + TT % |
| 16 QAM | 12.5 + TT % |
| 64 QAM | 8 + TT % |
| 256 QAM | 3.5 + TT % |

TT 來源摘錄為：

| 條件 | TT |
|---|---|
| All except 256QAM | 0% |
| 256 QAM @ max power | 0.3% |
| 256 QAM @ min power | 1.1% |

來源範例：DUT on n78、100 MHz BW、PUCCH Test ID 1（QPSK）時，specified maximum EVM 為 **17.5 + 0 %**，且 CMX EVM measurement 位於 3GPP limits 內。

EVM › 使用限制
- 本頁不是完整 EVM measurement tutorial，也不是 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] 標準全文。
- [[WIC Glossary]] 只提供縮寫展開；[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 與 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 只提供 selected NR-FR1 SA test case 摘要。
- 不可由此頁推論 FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi、LTE、NR 或 production line test 的所有 EVM limits。
- 任何正式 pass / fail limit 應回查對應標準、儀器文件、software version 與 test condition。

EVM › 來源定義
依 [[WIC Glossary]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- EVM 展開為 Error Vector Magnitude。

依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]（06.2025）：

- Error Vector Magnitude（EVM）是 reference waveform 與 measured waveform 之間差異的量測。
- 來源將 EVM 放在 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] test case **6.4.2.1 Error Vector Magnitude PUCCH/PUSCH**。
- Test ID 會設定 RB Allocation 與 modulation scheme。
- PUCCH subtests 需參考 application note chapter 2.1 notes。
- Apply configuration 後，需確認 measured DUT EVM 位於 specified range 內。
- Test case 要求在 DUT max power 與 min power 下量測 EVM。
- CMX 會先自動設定 max power；完成 max power EVM verification 後，DUT 需使用 TPC Closed Loop settings 設定為 min power。

[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 對同一 test case 的定義與限值摘要相同，並支撐既有 EVM 頁面內容。

EVM
[[EVM]] 是 Error Vector Magnitude；[[WIC Glossary]] 只提供縮寫展開，[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 與 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 則在 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance test case 6.4.2.1 中說明 EVM 是 reference waveform 與 measured waveform 之間差異的量測。

EVM › 與既有測試脈絡的關係
- [[FWA CPE]] 與 [[FWA CPE 測試與驗證]] 中的戶外高階 mmWave ODU DVT 項目列出 FR2 EVM，但來源未提供 EVM limit、測試配置或標準章節。
- [[Small Cell BTS 測試資料清單]] 保存 base station Tx / Rx / OTA tests 檔名，但附件未擷取，因此不能補充 EVM 測項。
- [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 補入的是 NR-FR1 SA UE pre-conformance EVM PUCCH/PUSCH 脈絡，不等同 FR2、Wi-Fi、LTE、base station 或 production-line EVM limits。

EVM › unresolved
- EVM 的完整公式、filtering、averaging、reference waveform 產生方式與 test equipment uncertainty 未由 [[WIC Glossary]] 提供。
- [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 只摘錄 selected 3GPP conformance limits；完整 tables 需回查 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]]。
- [[FWA CPE]] 中 FR2 EVM 的標準依據與測試條件未標示。

EVM › 與 min power 的關係
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]：

- [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] Table 6.3.1.3-1 定義 minimum power（Pmin）。
- Channel BW 3–20 MHz 的 minimum output power 為 -40 dBm。
- Channel BW 25–100 MHz 的 minimum output power 為 -40 + 10log10(BW/20)。
- 256QAM Test IDs 的 target power 為 **Pmin + 10 dB**。
- 來源另以 100 MHz BW 說明 min power according to Table 6.3.1.3-1 略低於 33 dB；此處照來源摘要保留單位字樣，不自行改寫。

FR1 小細胞基站符合性測試框架 › 不可推論的內容
- 不可由本來源推論最新 3GPP Release 或完整 test case list。
- 不可由 `完整測試框架` 推論已涵蓋所有認證、營運商驗收、EMC / EMF 與 cybersecurity requirements。
- 不可由本來源推論 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器配置、option、license 或報價。
- 不可由 NCC 頻段頁推論台灣完整法規條文、公告日期、型式認證流程或資安審查細節。
- 不可由檔名或標題推論簡報正式發布日。

SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 `R&S®SMM100A Vector Signal Generator Specifications`，文件代碼 `PD 3608.7680.22`，`Version 31.00`；來源開頭標示 `June 2026`，文件識別段落標示 `May 2026 (nv)`，日期仍未決。

[[R&S SMM100A]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 vector signal generator。依本來源，frequency options 覆蓋 `100 kHz to 6 GHz`、`7.5 GHz`、`12.75 GHz`、`20 GHz`、`31.8 GHz` 與 `44 GHz`，最高輸出功率標示為 `up to +18 dBm`，internal RF modulation bandwidth 最高 `2 GHz`。來源定位包含 5G NR FR1/FR2 signal generation、future WLAN requirements、ARB、real-time baseband、custom digital modulation、envelope tracking、frequency response correction、HUMS 與 SCPI automation。

Product data 適用條件：在 ambient temperature 儲存 `3 hours` 後，warm-up operation `30 minutes`；符合 specified environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；已執行所有 applicable internal automatic adjustments。Non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

來源末尾描述：

- Rohde & Schwarz electronics group 提供 test and measurement、broadcast and media、secure communications、cybersecurity、monitoring and network testing 解決方案。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 標準與測試範圍
來源說 [[3GPP]] 負責標準化，並在 [[3GPP TS 38.141]] 定義 NR [[Base Station]] RF conformance test methods and requirements，涵蓋：

- transmitter（Tx）
- receiver（Rx）
- performance（Px）

[[3GPP TS 38.141]] 依測試方法分為兩部分：

- [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] Part 1：Conducted conformance testing。
- [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]] Part 2：Radiated conformance testing。

來源引用的 literature：

- [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] Release 16 V16.3.0（2020）：NR Base station conformance testing, Part 1: Conducted conformance testing。
- [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]] Release 16 V16.3.0（2020）：NR Base Station conformance testing Part 2: Radiated conformance testing。
- [[3GPP TS 38.104]] Release 16 V16.3.0（2020）：NR Base Station radio transmission and reception。
- Rohde & Schwarz, 5G NR Technology Introduction（2019）。
- Rohde & Schwarz, Remote Control and Instrument Drivers。
- Rohde & Schwarz, Introducing SCPI Commands。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 5G NR 技術背景
來源列出 5G NR 三大主要服務類型：

- Enhanced mobile broadband（eMBB）：提高終端使用者資料速率。
- Massive machine type communications（mMTC）：目標為具成本效率且穩健的 D2X connections。
- Ultra-reliable, low latency communications（URLLC）：支援自動駕駛、遠端手術、cloud robotics 等 vertical industries 的需求。

來源另指出 5G New Radio 技術背景可參考 Rohde & Schwarz book [3] 與 `www.rohde-schwarz.com/5G`。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 6.5.3 Modulation quality
- 定義為 measured carrier signal 與 reference signal 的差異。
- 可用 EVM 表示。
- EVM 是 equalization 後 ideal symbols 與 measured symbols 的差異讀值，該差異稱為 error vector。

EVM requirements：

- QPSK：18.5%。
- 16QAM：13.5%。
- 64QAM：9%。
- 256QAM：4.5%。

Frequency error 與 EVM SCPI 摘錄：

- `CONFigure[:NR5G]:DL[:CC<cc>]:IDC <State>`
- `FETCh[:CC<cc>][:ISRC<ant>][:FRAMe<fr>]:SUMMary:FERRor[:AVERage]?`
- `FETCh[:CC<cc>][:ISRC<ant>][:FRAMe<fr>]:SUMMary:EVM[:ALL][:AVERage]?`

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 重點摘要
- 文件名稱：`5G New Radio Conducted Base Station Transmitter Tests according to TS 38.141-1, Rel. 16`。
- 文件類型：Rohde & Schwarz Application Note。
- 文件代號：`GFM313`。
- 版本：`3e`。
- 日期：`01.2021`。
- 作者：Christian Wicke、Bernhard Schulz、Fabian Bette。
- 文件網址：`https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/appnote/GFM313`。
- 文件範圍：依 [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] Release 16 V16.3.0 chapter 6 執行所有 mandatory RF transmitter tests。
- 文件只涵蓋 [[single carrier]]（SC）tests 與 conducted measurements。
- [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] chapter 7 receiver tests 由 [[GFM314]] 說明；chapter 8 performance tests 由 [[GFM315]] 說明。
- OTA transmitter / receiver tests 分別指向 [[GFM324]] 與 [[GFM325]]。
- 測試可用 Rohde & Schwarz signal 或 spectrum analyzers，以 manual operation 或 remote control approach 執行。
- 其中 [[Transmitter intermodulation]] test case 6.7 需要額外 signal generator 產生 interferer。
- 來源附帶 software libraries / Python package / QuickStep testmodules，示範 remote-control approach；software 以 `as is` 形式提供。
- 安全注意事項：base stations 可能產生非常高的 output powers，需使用合適 attenuators 以避免 test equipment 損壞。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests
這是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Application Note [[GFM313]] Version 3e（01.2021）《5G New Radio Conducted Base Station Transmitter Tests according to TS 38.141-1, Rel. 16》的來源摘要，說明如何依 [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] Release 16 V16.3.0 對 5G NR [[Base Station]] 執行 conducted transmitter tests。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 6.2 Base station output power
測試目的：驗證 maximum carrier output power 在 frequency range、normal conditions、extreme conditions 下的準確度。

Declared rated output power limits：

- Wide area BS：No upper limit。
- Medium range BS：
  - BS type 1-C：≤ 38 dBm。
  - BS type 1-H：≤ 38 dBm + 10log(NTXU,counted)。
  - Prated,TAB：≤ 38 dBm。
- Local area BS：
  - BS type 1-C：≤ 24 dBm。
  - BS type 1-H：≤ 24 dBm + 10log(NTXU,counted)。
  - Prated,TAB：≤ 24 dBm。

BS output power requirements：

- f ≤ 3.0 GHz：normal conditions ±2.7 dB；extreme conditions ±3.2 dB。
- 3.0 GHz < f < 6.0 GHz：normal conditions ±3.0 dB；extreme conditions ±3.5 dB。

SCPI 摘錄：

- `INSTrument[:SELect] NR5G`
- `CONFigure[:NR5G]:MEASurement EVM`
- `MMEMory:LOAD:TMODel[:CC<cc>] <TestModel>`
- `[SENSe:]FREQuency:CENTer <Frequency>`
- `INPut:ATTenuation <Attenuation>`
- `CONFigure[:NR5G]:DL[:CC<cc>]:IDC <State>`
- `FETCh[:CC<cc>][:FRAMe<fr>]:SUMMary:POWer:MAXimum?`

R&S SMM100A › 適用條件與規格定義
依 [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]]，產品資料適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 `3 hours` 後，warm-up operation `30 minutes`；符合 specified environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；已執行所有 applicable internal automatic adjustments。

R&S SMM100A › 定位與用途
依 [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]]，[[R&S SMM100A]] 的主要能力包含：

- Frequency range：`100 kHz to 44 GHz`。
- High output power：up to `+18 dBm`。
- Internal RF modulation bandwidth：up to `2 GHz`。
- 支援 5G NR signal generation for FR1 and FR2。
- RF frequency 與 modulation bandwidth 用於 future WLAN requirements。
- Excellent SSB phase noise、EVM、ACPR/ACLR performance。
- Internal real-time signal generation。
- Arbitrary waveform generator。
- Custom digital modulation。

EVM is Error Vector Magnitude, and in the 5G NR FR1 SA UE pre-conformance context it is a measurement of the difference between a reference waveform and a measured waveform [3][4].
In Rohde & Schwarz base-station Tx context, modulation quality is the difference between the measured carrier signal and the reference signal, it can be expressed as EVM, and EVM is the difference reading between equalized ideal symbols and measured symbols, with that difference called the error vector [53].
The UE pass/fail-limit decision depends on modulation and test tolerance, because the cited 3GPP TS 38.521-1 limits are Pi/2-BPSK 30+TT %, QPSK 17.5+TT %, 16QAM 12.5+TT %, 64QAM 8+TT %, and 256QAM 3.5+TT %, with TT values depending on 256QAM max/min power conditions [1].
The UE test-configuration decision depends on EVM because the 3GPP TS 38.521-1 test case is 6.4.2.1 EVM PUCCH/PUSCH, the Test ID sets RB allocation and modulation scheme, and the measured DUT EVM must be confirmed within the specified range after configuration [3].
The UE power-condition decision depends on EVM because the test case requires EVM measurement at DUT max power and min power, with CMX first setting max power automatically and the DUT then being set to min power using TPC Closed Loop settings [3].
The standards-scope decision depends on EVM because the knowledge base warns not to infer all FR1, FR2, Wi-Fi, LTE, NR, or production-line EVM limits from the cited page, and formal pass/fail limits must be checked against the relevant standard, instrument documents, software version, and test condition [2].
For R&S CMX500, the NR FR1 measurement-option decision depends on EVM because R&S CMX-KM600 is required for any NR FR1 uplink TX tests, and its 5G NR analyzer specification includes EVM < 0.5% under the stated FR1, SCS 30 kHz, 16QAM, +15 °C to +35 °C, input-level, and 100 MHz bandwidth conditions [22].
For R&S CMX500 signal generation, the R&S CMX-KW601 option decision depends on EVM because its 5G NR generator specification includes EVM < 0.5% for 5G NR PDSCH, full allocation, SCS 30 kHz / 60 kHz, 64QAM, PAR 11.8 dB, +15 °C to +35 °C, specified ports, –5 dBm output level, and 100 MHz bandwidth [22].
For CMX500 ordering, the cited complete order numbers are R&S CMX-KM600 5G NR analyzer 1222.4013.02 and R&S CMX-KW601 5G NR generator 1222.1920.02 [26].
For FR2 CMX setups, the RF frontend level-range decision depends on EVM because R&S CMX-RF42E provides specified TX/downlink and RX/uplink output level ranges “for best EVM” in the CMX500 + 2 × CMXHEAD50 + CMX-RF42E setup [25][29].
For SRS RF measurements on CMX500, the measurement-scenario decision depends on EVM because the CMX500 SRS RF measurement use case covers TX power, EVM, and more for 5G NR SRS modes/configurations, including SRS antenna switching and carrier switching scenarios [33][34].
FSET3 for SRS carrier switching but does not provide the complete order number or confirm whether R&S CMX-KM600, R&S CMX-KM604, receiver-chain hardware, or other measurement options are required [35].
For R&S base-station conducted transmitter testing, the instrument-selection decision depends on EVM because GFM313 covers 5G NR conducted base-station transmitter tests according to TS 38.141-1 Rel. 16 and includes modulation-quality/EVM requirements of QPSK 18.5%, 16QAM 13.5%, 64QAM 9%, and 256QAM 4.5% [53][54][55].
For that GFM313 context, applicable Rohde & Schwarz products include R&S FSW, R&S FSV3000, R&S FSVA3000, R&S FSV, R&S FSVA, R&S FPS, R&S SMW200A, R&S SMBV100B, and R&S VSE Signal Analysis Software [57].
For R&S base-station conformance setup, the analyzer/generator role decision depends on EVM because the R&S setup figures connect BS type 1-C output power, output power dynamics, frequency error, EVM, and unwanted emissions to R&S FSVA3000, while transmitter intermodulation examples use R&S SMW200A for wanted, modulated interferer, and CW interferer contexts [44].
For R&S FSV3000-family firmware, the option decision depends on EVM because R&S FSV3-K147 is “5G NR combined ACLR/SEM/EVM” and requires R&S FSV3-K144, while R&S FSV3-K147C adds combined multicarrier ACLR/SEM/EVM measurements and requires R&S FSV3-K147 [62].
For R&S SMM100A, the signal-source capability decision depends on EVM because the SMM100A specifications list signal performance examples including 5G NR EVM with R&S SMM-K144, 3GPP FDD EVM with R&S SMM-K42, and IEEE 802.11be EVM with R&S SMM-K147 [11].
For R&S SMM100A measurement-context fit, the product facts are that it is a Rohde & Schwarz vector signal generator covering 100 kHz to 44 GHz, supporting up to 2 GHz internal RF modulation bandwidth, and supporting 5G NR FR1/FR2, ARB, real-time baseband, custom digital modulation, envelope tracking, and HUMS [61].
【推論】Understanding EVM is needed before choosing a standard limit, modulation, Test ID, and power condition, because the cited EVM limits vary by modulation and TT while the test case sets RB allocation/modulation and requires max-power and min-power EVM checks [1][3].
【推論】Understanding EVM is needed before choosing R&S analyzer, generator, frontend, and firmware options, because the CMX500, CMX-RF42E, SMM100A, and FSV3000 cited product passages explicitly specify EVM performance, best-EVM level ranges, EVM signal-performance examples, or EVM measurement options [11][22][25][29][62].

- 定義為 measured carrier signal 與 reference signal 的差異。
- 可用 EVM 表示。
- EVM 是 equalization 後 ideal symbols 與 measured symbols 的差異讀值，該差異稱為 error vector。

EVM requirements：

- QPSK：18.5%。
- 16QAM：13.5%。
- 64QAM：9%。
- 256QAM：4.5%。

Frequency error 與 EVM SCPI 摘錄：

- `CONFigure[:NR5G]:DL[:CC<cc>]:IDC <State>`
- `FETCh[:CC<cc>][:ISRC<ant>][:FRAMe<fr>]:SUMMary:FERRor[:AVERage]?`
- `FETCh[:CC<cc>][:ISRC<ant>][:FRAMe<fr>]:SUMMary:EVM[:ALL][:AVERage]?`

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 重點摘要
- 文件名稱：`5G New Radio Conducted Base Station Transmitter Tests according to TS 38.141-1, Rel. 16`。
- 文件類型：Rohde & Schwarz Application Note。
- 文件代號：`GFM313`。
- 版本：`3e`。
- 日期：`01.2021`。
- 作者：Christian Wicke、Bernhard Schulz、Fabian Bette。
- 文件網址：`https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/appnote/GFM313`。
- 文件範圍：依 [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] Release 16 V16.3.0 chapter 6 執行所有 mandatory RF transmitter tests。
- 文件只涵蓋 [[single carrier]]（SC）tests 與 conducted measurements。
- [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] chapter 7 receiver tests 由 [[GFM314]] 說明；chapter 8 performance tests 由 [[GFM315]] 說明。
- OTA transmitter / receiver tests 分別指向 [[GFM324]] 與 [[GFM325]]。
- 測試可用 Rohde & Schwarz signal 或 spectrum analyzers，以 manual operation 或 remote control approach 執行。
- 其中 [[Transmitter intermodulation]] test case 6.7 需要額外 signal generator 產生 interferer。
- 來源附帶 software libraries / Python package / QuickStep testmodules，示範 remote-control approach；software 以 `as is` 形式提供。
- 安全注意事項：base stations 可能產生非常高的 output powers，需使用合適 attenuators 以避免 test equipment 損壞。

R&S SMM100A
[[R&S SMM100A]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Vector Signal Generator；依 `R&S®SMM100A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` `Version 31.00`，透過 `R&S®SMM-B10xx` frequency options 覆蓋 `100 kHz to 6 GHz` 到 `100 kHz to 44 GHz`，並支援最高 `2 GHz` internal RF modulation bandwidth、5G NR FR1/FR2、ARB、real-time baseband、custom digital modulation、envelope tracking 與 HUMS（來源：[[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]]）。

⚠️ [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]]（June 2026）讀圖補充 p049 與 p051 頁尾說 `R&S®SMW100A Vector Signal Generator`，但既有頁面 [[R&S SMM100A]] 說本文件產品為 `R&S®SMM100A Vector Signal Generator`。判斷為來源頁尾疑似誤植；本頁仍以封面、p050、文件名稱、ordering information 與 source_path 的 `SMM100A` 為主，並在 Unresolved 保留此不一致。

⚠️ [[R&S for JIO Project]]（2026-09-17 converted；來源未標示正式日期）說 [[R&S SMM100A]] Frequency Range: Up to 67 GHz，但既有頁面 [[R&S SMM100A]] 說依 [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]]（June 2026 / May 2026 未決）SMM100A 最高 frequency option 為 100 kHz to 44 GHz。判斷：[[R&S for JIO Project]] 是 Market / project deck，且同一簡報 slide 24 另列 [[R&S SMA100B]] 8 kHz to 67 GHz；因此 67 GHz 很可能是簡報混淆或 sales-slide 錯植。正式規格以 [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]] 為準，Jio WoMT use-case 中引用此簡報時需保留矛盾。
